title: PLAIN LANGUAGE QUESTING RETURN PATH
description: The change is pitched as onboarding, but it quietly rewires what the team thinks a beginner is worth. Quest text now says what to do before explaining which ancient committee made it necessary. Declining the shop now returns players to a smaller, friendlier offer instead of the game.
consequence: Players discovered the objective without consulting three tabs and a priest. The back button became a polite hallway with prices.

title: PLAIN LANGUAGE QUESTING ESCAPE ROUTE
description: The update makes the game easier to explain from the outside, with consequences for those still inside. Quest text now says what to do before explaining which ancient committee made it necessary. Shop exits now send players back to the last activity without a second offer or educational delay.
consequence: Players discovered the objective without consulting three tabs and a priest. The funnel lost a wall and several people escaped through it.

title: MINIMAL GUIDANCE MODE RETURN PATH
description: The change softens one part of the product while sharpening another part that can be measured. Several prompts have been removed so discovery can emerge naturally from confusion and patch forum archaeology. Declining the shop now returns players to a smaller, friendlier offer instead of the game.
consequence: The tutorial got shorter. So did the time before players asked what was happening. The back button became a polite hallway with prices.
